_about: The brief, in one editable file: jobs/<job>/brief.json. The creator's own words first, then what they mean, decided once and carried through every stage.
node tools/plan/brief.mjs check jobs/<job> lists the few questions whose answers would change the film, and the shots that cannot yet prove what they promise.
node tools/plan/brief.mjs show jobs/<job> prints the short version a stage session reads instead of the whole history.
kind: product-demo | launch-reel | motion-graphics | footage-edit | ugc | animated-short | promo | tutorial. Each has its own production path (knowledge/playbooks/).
voice: voice-over | presenter | dialogue | none. 'none' means music and type carry the film.
deliver: every size the film must exist in. One is the master (true); the rest are cut from it.

references[].liked_for: what the creator likes about it, from: camera, pacing, edit, delivery, performance, look, type, sound, structure, story, character. Ask when it is empty: it decides what gets copied.
references[].moments: the seconds in the reference that show it. references[].use: study-only (other people's films: never placed in ours) | owned | licensed.
must_show[].evidence: what the viewer literally sees that proves it ('the tool calls with done ticks', not 'it connects'). shots[].proves in shots.json names the must_show it carries.
materials[].rights: own | licensed | consented (people) | study-only. Anything else cannot go in a finished film.
decisions: answers that hold for the whole job. applies_to: all, or scene ids. Written once; every stage reads them.
